subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark criteria, owners, timelines
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@caregrid.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark criteria, owners, timelines

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for a great discussion today. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MA plan) focused on the technical evaluation milestone we discussed. I pulled together a short, testable milestone definition so both teams can clearly validate readiness. Highlights below; full draft attached (redwood-map-draft-v1.2.pdf) and benchmark matrix (benchmark-matrix-caregrid.csv).

Technical evaluation milestone (single page summary)
- Success criteria (primary): model produces >= 92% intent classification accuracy on the 2k labeled readout set OR NDCG@10 >= 0.88 on the rerank task (pick primary task per dataset)
- Latency targets: p95 inference latency <= 220ms for 1k-token prompts in the test harness (single-request, no batching) and p95 <= 120ms for 256-token median prompts on dedicated environment
- Cost target: inference cost <= $0.70 per 1k generated tokens at the target throughput (measured on Redwood Dedicated baseline configuration)
- Model shortlist for benchmarking: Llama-3 (70B), Mistral-Instruct (7B), Redwood-Compat-v1-quant (8-bit) — Redwood will run the first pass; CareGrid may request a candidate to be added

Owners and responsibilities
- Redwood (Ben / Karthik): provide prebuilt benchmark harness, runner scripts, and access to a small dedicated test pool. Run first-pass benchmarks and provide csv results and raw logs.
- CareGrid (Elena / Eval Team): provide anonymized 2k evaluation set, label schema, and acceptance criteria for biz metrics. Validate outputs and confirm acceptance window.
- Joint: security review & SOC2 evidence exchange (see dependencies)

Dependencies / blockers
- CareGrid to share eval dataset and ACL for sample S3 bucket by 2026-08-14
- SOC2 checklist & IP network allowlist for Redwood test IPs (we'll share an evidence pack)
- Provisioning of Dedicated sandbox (Redwood to confirm capacity)

Proposed milestone timeline (target close for Technical Eval):
- Week 0 (2026-08-10): dataset delivery + sandbox keys
- Week 1 (2026-08-17): Redwood runs first-pass benchmark (models above)
- Week 2 (2026-08-24): results readout; iteration plan if criteria not met
- Week 3 (2026-08-31): final acceptance window and sign-off

Target close date for the MAP technical milestone: 2026-08-31.

Can you confirm dataset delivery date, and whether CareGrid wants additional models added to the shortlist? Once confirmed we'll lock the SOW milestone dates into the MA plan and move the security checklist to the queue.

Best,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
"Redwood — inference engineered for production"
---
Attachments: redwood-map-draft-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf), benchmark-matrix-caregrid.csv (text/csv), sample-scorer.py (text/x-python)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@caregrid.health>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: CareGrid Evaluation Team <eval-team@caregrid.health>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark criteria, owners, timelines

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and draft. Quick answers from our side: we can deliver the 2k anonymized readout set by EOD 2026-08-14 (shared to the S3 bucket you indicated) and we confirm the acceptance metric will be the intent classification accuracy for this engagement (we'll include NDCG as a secondary metric).

A few clarifying questions:
1) Can you confirm which runner (CPU/GPU type) you'll use for the latency numbers? We need p95 numbers from a baseline comparable to our expected production (A100-like).
2) For the cost target, is that using Redwood Dedicated reserved pricing or Hosted API pricing? We want the numbers to reflect an on-prem/dedicated model cost because of throughput.
3) We may request an additional small model (Mistral-7B-chat) to check safety/regression vectors — is that low lift for you to add?

We'll also start our side of the internal security review; I'll loop our security lead if anything else comes up. Looking forward to the first pass.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of ML Ops, CareGrid Health
elena@caregrid.health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark criteria, owners, timelines

Tessa / Karthik —

Forwarding Elena's reply. Quick internal alignment notes:
- Runner/hardware: we'll run the latency/cost profile on a single A100-80GB equivalent node (Dedicated sandbox). Call out that single-request p95 numbers will be based on that. For 256-token median prompts we'll profile on a lower-cost T4-equivalent to show cost curves (helps CareGrid with budget scenarios).
- Cost target: the $0.70 / 1k tokens stated in the MAP should be measured using Redwood Dedicated baseline pricing (reserved hourly rate). We'll include the Hosted API comparative numbers for completeness in the results csv.
- Mistral-7B-chat add is fine; Karthik can spin the container and include safety/regression checks in the harness (low lift).

Action items:
- Karthik: prep benchmark runner + initial config (deadline 2026-08-12) and create runner image with Mistral-7B-chat included.
- Connor: confirm sandbox capacity and ingest ACLs with infra (confirm by 2026-08-11).
- Tessa: confirm dataset S3 path with Elena and upload security allowlist and evidence pack.

I'll own the first-pass result aggregation once runs complete.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@caregrid.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone — benchmark criteria, owners, timelines

Great — thanks Elena, and thanks Ben/Karthik/Connor for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and owners so we have a single canonical tracker: 

1) CareGrid (Elena): deliver anonymized 2k readout set to s3://caregrid-eval/redwood-sandbox by 2026-08-14. Include label schema and a short README.
2) Redwood (Karthik / Ben): provision Dedicated sandbox, build runner image (include Mistral-7B-chat), run first-pass benchmarks and upload results + raw logs to the shared Drive by 2026-08-17.
3) Security: Redwood to share SOC2 evidence pack and test IP allowlist by 2026-08-11; CareGrid to confirm any additional requirements by 2026-08-13.
4) Readout: joint call to review results and next steps on 2026-08-19 (TBD time).

Target milestone acceptance date remains 2026-08-31. If the benchmark results fall short we will propose a remediation iteration (small prompt engineering + quantization profile change) with a one-week follow-up window.

I'll update the MA plan doc and push v1.3 after you confirm the dataset path.

Best,
Tessa

--
